data.description:
# Guard the provider session: wrap run() in `with ProviderSession(...)`

ADR 0055 decision 2. A CORRECTNESS fix, not a refactor -- independently valuable, should land even if
the rest of the decomposition is descoped.

## The defect (VERIFIED in source at 97791145f)

    runner.py:301   provider_session = ProviderSession(cfg)   # its builders open httpx clients
    runner.py:474   try:                                       # <-- guard starts 173 lines later
    runner.py:582   finally: provider_session.close()

Lines 301-473 sit OUTSIDE the guard, and several raise BY DESIGN: _check_tool_capability raises
LLMConfigError at 325, and task cc33 builds N clients in that window. Anything raising there leaks an
opened httpx.AsyncClient -- one per affected call.

ProviderSession.__enter__/__exit__ ALREADY EXIST (providers.py:295-299) and are never used:
`grep -c 'with ProviderSession' src/rebar/llm/runner.py` returns 0. Meanwhile providers.py:21
documents "runner.run() wraps its body in `with ProviderSession(cfg) as session:`" -- the module
docstring describes a caller that does not exist. This ticket makes it true.

## Approach

Move construction into a `with` covering provider resolution through the call and teardown, and drop
the now-redundant `finally: provider_session.close()` -- __exit__ owns it. Preserve the existing
best-effort semantics (close logs, never raises).

CONSTRAINT: `assert_gated("agentic filesystem tools")` at runner.py:256 is a FAIL-CLOSED security
check and MUST stay ahead of provider construction. Do not reorder it into the guarded region in a
way that opens a client before the refusal path runs.

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/runner.py -- the `with`, and removal of the redundant finally
- tests/unit/

## Testing

Unit tier with a stubbed builder recording opens/closes; no network.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] a test asserts that when the pre-call window raises (e.g. _check_tool_capability), the session's
      client is STILL closed -- this FAILS against the current code, so it cannot pass vacuously
- [ ] a test asserts the happy path closes EXACTLY once (a `with` plus a leftover `finally` would
      double-close, which the stub must be able to detect)
- [ ] `grep -c 'with ProviderSession' src/rebar/llm/runner.py` is 1, so providers.py:21 no longer
      documents an absent caller
- [ ] a close that raises is still logged and never propagated (the best-effort semantics are unchanged)
data.title: Guard the provider session with a context manager in run()
